rationale: The agent authenticated the user via matching email to a single account, then reviewed the user’s orders. It asked the user to specify which order to act on, checked order status for eligibility, and obtained explicit confirmation (including reason) before performing the cancellation. The cancellation was executed through the proper tool, and the final message accurately reflected the tool’s outcome, including refund to the user’s PayPal. No unsupported claims or unauthorized actions were made. A minor improvement could have been offering to check all orders’ statuses or clarify partial-item cancellation options, but the user consented to cancel the entire eligible order, satisfying the request within policy.
